activations.name: tokens
activations.meaning: B=rows in the batch, T=positions; each entry is a token id in [0, V).  Unshifted -- this is what the harness is handed

activations.name: valid
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions; True where the position holds a real token rather than padding

activations.name: tok_emb
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; one learned vector per token id

activations.name: pos_emb
activations.meaning: 1=broadcast over rows, T=positions, D=d_model; one learned vector per absolute position

activations.name: resid_in
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the residual stream as it enters block 0

activations.name: attn_bias
activations.meaning: B=rows, 1=broadcast over heads, T_q=querying position, T_k=attended position; 0 where the edge is allowed and -inf where it is not

activations.name: block0.norm1
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the residual stream normalised per position before attention reads it

activations.name: block0.attn.qkv
activations.meaning: B=rows in the batch, T=positions, 3D=query, key and value packed into one projection so it is a single matmul

activations.name: block0.attn.q
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=the position asking, Dh=d_model/H, the slice of the channel this head owns

activations.name: block0.attn.k
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=the position being asked about, Dh=per-head width

activations.name: block0.attn.v
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=the position whose content gets carried, Dh=per-head width

activations.name: block0.attn.scores
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T_q=querying position, T_k=attended position; entry (b,h,i,j) is how much i wants j

activations.name: block0.attn.weights
activations.meaning: same axes as scores, now a distribution over T_k for each (row, head, T_q) -- each slice sums to 1

activations.name: block0.attn.context
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=positions, Dh=per-head width; the value vectors averaged with the attention weights

activations.name: block0.attn.merged
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the heads concatenated back into one channel axis

activations.name: block0.attn.out
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; attention's contribution to the residual stream

activations.name: block0.resid_attn
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; residual stream with attention's answer added back -- nothing overwritten

activations.name: block0.norm2
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; normalised again before the FFN reads it

activations.name: block0.ffn.hidden
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, F=d_ff, the wide inner width; one branch decides what to pass, the other how much

activations.name: block0.ffn.out
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the FFN's contribution to the residual stream

activations.name: block0.resid_ffn
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; residual stream leaving this block

activations.name: hidden
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the final hidden state. Every token now has a vector that has seen its context

activations.name: logits
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, V=vocab size; one unnormalised score for every token the model could name next, at every position.  V/D = 39x larger than the hidden state that produced it

activations.name: logits[:, :-1]
activations.meaning: B=rows, P=positions that have something to predict, V=vocab; the last positions are dropped because nothing follows them

activations.name: targets
activations.meaning: B=rows, P=pairs; the token id each position must name. Position i of the row is token i+1 of the sequence

activations.name: flat_logits
activations.meaning: N=B*P, one row per prediction the batch will be scored on, V=vocab; cross_entropy has no use for the batch and position axes, so they are folded into one

activations.name: flat_targets
activations.meaning: N=B*P; one correct id per row of flat_logits, in the same order

activations.name: per_token_loss
activations.meaning: B=rows, P=pairs; -log(probability the model gave the true token) at each position, before anything is masked

activations.name: loss_mask
activations.meaning: B=rows, P=pairs; True where the pair is allowed to contribute. Its sum is the denominator, and it is not B*P

activations.name: loss
activations.meaning: a scalar in nats: the mean surprise per contributing token. This is the one number the whole forward pass exists to produce
